description: Tier 1 trigger evals — does the right skill fire for a given prompt? These skills are typically installed alongside the open zime-gtm-skills set, so the collision risk runs both ways: e.g. call-prep must fire on pre-call prep intents, and must NOT fire on post-call review intents that belong to the open repo's audit skills (should_trigger: null means no skill in THIS repo should fire). Run via skill-creator's scripts/run_eval.py.
